t: Tenneco Automotive's RANCHO® Suspension Products Expand 2WD Suspension System Line | Tenneco
s: April 13, 2021 - RANCHO's new 2WD suspension systems feature heavy-duty construction with precision MIG welding throughout. All steel parts are coated with either RANCHO red powder coating or plating for long service life. Both RANCHO's new self-adjusting premium RSX and five-speed adjustable RS9000 high-performance shocks are available for use with the new 2WD systems.
